help.title: Help
help.metaDescription: What a decant is, how long 2, 5 and 10 ml last, and delivery in Ulaanbaatar, payment and returns: your questions answered.
help.heading: FAQ and delivery
help.contactText: Call us or message us on social media.

faq.a: A decant is the original fragrance transferred from its retail bottle into a small, sterilised spray vial. The scent is identical — only the size is smaller — so you can test it properly for a fraction of the price of a full bottle.
Yes. We only decant from authentic bottles. [[TODO owner]] Add sourcing and guarantee details here.

faq.q: How long do 2, 5 and 10 ml last?
faq.a: 2 ml is roughly 25 sprays — enough to test one scent for about a week. 5 ml lasts two to three weeks, and 10 ml covers more than a month of daily wear.
[[TODO owner]] Within Ulaanbaatar we deliver 24–48 hours after the order is confirmed. Orders to the provinces are sent by intercity carrier; the carrier fee is paid by the recipient.

After you place an order we call you to confirm it. You then pay by bank transfer or QPay, writing your order number in the transfer description. Once the payment arrives, your order goes out for delivery.
[[TODO owner]] Fragrance is a hygiene product, so opened decants cannot be returned. If your order arrives damaged or incorrect, let us know within 48 hours and we will replace it.

faq.q: How should I store a decant?
faq.a: Keep it away from direct sunlight and heat, somewhere cool and dark. Stored well, the scent stays true for a long time.
